item.text:
Yes. An agent can use Mistral’s built-in `web_search` tool and return JSON.

Configure the agent with:

- `tools=[{"type": "web_search"}]`
- `completion_args={"response_format": {"type": "json_object"}}`

Mistral documents that web search works with the Agents and Conversations APIs, and that agent `completion_args` accept standard chat-completion arguments. JSON mode also requires instructing the model in the prompt to produce JSON. The search references are returned as separate reference chunks alongside the message output.

Sources: [Web Search tool](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/websearch), [Agents & Conversations API](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api), [Structured Outputs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output).
